primary.meaning: Every available persisted normalized session/imported aggregate is candidate history, including pre-mirror ranges. No live store opened; contents/completeness/readability not asserted. mirror.behavior: Daily/app/hour summary; active hint augmentation, atomic write, attempted POSIX0600. Not lossless archive; window never limits intended complete available donor backfill. SQLite rollups split duration across hours but count a session only in its start hour. The mirror accepts rollup rows only when totalSeconds>0 AND sessionCount>0, dropping positive-duration continuation hours with no same-app session start. A lone synthetic 09:30–10:30 session therefore loses its 10:00–10:30 continuation from the mirror; cross-midnight continuation is likewise dropped unless another same-app/hour start contributes sessionCount. Raw fallback instead assigns whole duration by start day/hour. Neither mirror path qualifies faithful per-hour/day history; raw persisted sessions remain source authority.
